title: JoyCon controllers don't behave as expected on Android
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.6 stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Android 13 (SDK 33 build V816.0.4.0.TGKRUXM) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Adreno (TM) 610 -  (8 threads)

### Issue description

Switch JoyCon controllers don't behave as expected on Android devices:
- They are detected as 2 separate joypads
- On the left JoyCon D-pad buttons are not recognized and `Index (int)p_button = -168 is out of bounds` shows up in the console regardless of which d-pad button was pressed
- On the right JoyCon Y and X buttons are swapped
- When I press the right stick it gets detected as the right stick press, but when I move the stick Godot recognizes that as the left stick movement
- ZL and ZR are not recognized
- Home button is not recognized
- If only one JoyCon is connected, it's not treated as being held horizontally (it doesn't have a horizontal JoyCon button/axis layout that is used on desktop platforms in this case)

### Steps to reproduce

- Open https://gist.github.com/anthonyec/5342fce79b2b7b22ada748df0ad7f7c0 in Android Godot editor
- Connect both JoyCon controllers to the device
- Press the buttons on the controllers

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://gist.github.com/anthonyec/5342fce79b2b7b22ada748df0ad7f7c0
